ne_chest_wall_pushup.name: Wall Push-up
steps: Stand one step away from the wall, palms on the wall at chest height, shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows and bring your chest toward the wall, keeping your body straight.
Push back to the starting position.
tips: Step your feet back to add difficulty.

ne_chest_knee_pushup.name: Knee Push-up
steps: Rest on your knees and palms, hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your chest until it almost touches the floor, then push up.
tips: Keep your abs tight throughout the movement.

ne_chest_pushup.name: Standard Push-up
steps: Start in a high plank, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body as one straight line until your chest almost touches the floor.
Push up without locking your elbows.
tips: Keep your elbows about 45° from your body.

ne_chest_diamond.name: Diamond Push-up
steps: Get into a push-up position with both hands forming a diamond under your chest.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows close to your body.
Push up.
tips: Start from your knees if it is too hard.
commonMistakes: Wrist pain from an overly extreme angle.

ne_abs_dead_bug.name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back, arms straight up, knees bent at 90° above your hips.
Slowly lower your right arm and left leg without touching the floor.
Return, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.

ne_abs_crunch.name: Crunch
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands beside your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor by tightening your abs.
Lower slowly.
tips: Exhale as you come up.
commonMistakes: Pulling your neck with your hands.

ne_abs_leg_raise.name: Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back, legs straight and together.
Raise your legs until they are perpendicular to the floor.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.
tips: Bend your knees slightly if your back lifts.
commonMistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor.

ne_abs_plank.name: Plank
steps: Rest on your forearms and toes, elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Hold for the set duration.
tips: Squeeze your glutes and abs.

ne_arm_bench_dip.name: Chair Dip
steps: Sit on the edge of a stable chair, hands beside your hips, then slide your hips forward.
Bend your elbows to 90°.
Push back up.
tips: The farther your feet, the harder it gets.

ne_arm_wall_triceps.name: Close-grip Wall Push-up
steps: Hands on the wall shoulder-width apart, elbows close to your body.
Push up and down in a controlled way.
tips: Move slowly.

ne_arm_diamond_knee.name: Knee Diamond Push-up
steps: Get into a kneeling position with your hands forming a diamond.
Lower down and push back up.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your body.

ne_shoulder_arm_circles.name: Arm Circles
steps: Stand with your arms straight out to the sides.
Make small circles, then big ones, then switch direction.
tips: Keep the movement controlled.

ne_shoulder_pike_knee.name: Knee Pike Push-up
steps: Start on your knees with your hips high, forming an inverted V.
Bend your elbows so your head moves toward the floor between your hands.
Push back up.
tips: Look toward your feet.

ne_shoulder_pike.name: Pike Push-up
steps: Get into an inverted V position with straight legs.
Lower your head toward the floor, then push back up.
tips: The closer your feet, the harder it gets.

ne_back_superman.name: Superman
steps: Lie face down with your arms straight in front of you.
Lift your arms and legs at the same time.
Hold for 1-2 seconds, then lower.
tips: Keep your gaze on the floor.

ne_back_bird_dog.name: Bird Dog
steps: Start on all fours.
Extend your right arm and left leg.
Return, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your pelvis stable.

ne_back_reverse_plank.name: Reverse Plank
steps: Sit with your hands behind you and lift your hips.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Hold.
tips: Push your shoulders away from your ears.

ne_leg_squat.name: Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand up.
tips: Keep your chest upright.

ne_leg_lunge.name: Lunge
steps: Take a big step forward.
Lower your back knee almost to the floor.
Push back, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your front knee from going past your toes.

ne_leg_jump_squat.name: Jump Squat
steps: Squat, then jump explosively.
Land softly back into a squat.
tips: Land with your knees bent.

ne_full_march.name: Marching in Place
steps: Lift your knees alternately while swinging your arms.
Keep a steady rhythm.
tips: Keep an upright posture.

ne_full_burpee_no_jump.name: No-jump Burpee
steps: Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Step your feet back into a plank.
Return to the squat, then stand up.
tips: Keep a steady rhythm.

ne_full_burpee.name: Burpee
steps: Squat down, jump your feet back into a plank, do a push-up, return, then jump high.
tips: Land softly.

pb_chest_knee_pushup.name: Knee Chest Push-up
steps: Place both hands on the blue circles, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower your knees to the floor, body straight from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the board for 2 seconds with your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Push back up until your arms are almost straight.
tips: Tighten your abs so your hips do not drop.

pb_chest_pushup.name: Standard Chest Push-up
steps: Hands on the blue circles, legs straight and resting on your toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest until it almost touches the board, then push up.
tips: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you push.
commonMistakes: Head dropping or craning up too much.

pb_chest_decline.name: Decline Chest Push-up
steps: Rest both feet on a stable chair or bench at knee height.
Hands on the blue circles, body straight.
Lower your chest in a controlled 3 seconds, then push up hard.
tips: Make sure the chair does not slide before you start.
commonMistakes: Hips sagging, causing the lower back to arch.

pb_shoulder_knee.name: Knee Shoulder Push-up
steps: Hands on the red circles, knees on the floor, hips slightly raised.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the board.
Push up while keeping your hips high.
tips: Focus on feeling the load in your front shoulders.
commonMistakes: Hips dropping, turning it into a regular push-up.

pb_shoulder_pike.name: Pike Push-up
steps: Hands on the red circles, feet close to your hands, hips high in an inverted V.
Lower your head toward the board with your elbows pointing back and out.
Push back up to the V position.
tips: The closer your feet are to your hands, the more load goes to your shoulders.
commonMistakes: Bumping your head on the board by going too fast.

pb_shoulder_pike_elevated.name: Elevated Pike Push-up
steps: Rest your feet on a stable bench, hands on the red circles.
Raise your hips as high as possible so your arms and body form a sharp angle.
Lower your head in a controlled 3 seconds, then push up.
tips: Use a slow tempo to protect your shoulder joints.
commonMistakes: Too much load on the neck.

pb_back_plank.name: Yellow Zone Plank
steps: Hands on the yellow circles, arms straight under your shoulders.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Hold while pulling your shoulders away from your ears and tightening your abs.
tips: Note: the yellow zone is the manufacturer's hand-position guide. For a stronger lat workout, combine it with rope exercises (rows).

pb_back_pushup_pause.name: Paused Yellow Zone Push-up
steps: Hands on the yellow circles, body straight.
Lower your body and hold for 2 seconds at the bottom while pulling your shoulder blades back.
Push up.
tips: The pause builds control and shoulder blade stability.
commonMistakes: Holding your breath for too long.

pb_back_tempo.name: Slow Tempo Yellow Zone Push-up
steps: Hands on the yellow circles.
Lower for 4 seconds, hold 1 second at the bottom, rise for 1 second.
Keep your shoulder blades stable throughout.
tips: Reduce your reps if your form starts to break down.
commonMistakes: Speeding up at the end of the set.

pb_triceps_knee.name: Knee Triceps Push-up
steps: Hands on the green circles, knees on the floor.
Keep your elbows tucked against your body as you lower your chest.
Push up until your arms are straight.
tips: Imagine your elbows brushing the sides of your body.
commonMistakes: Elbows flaring out to the sides.

pb_triceps_pushup.name: Triceps Push-up
steps: Hands on the green circles, legs straight.
Keep your elbows tucked and pointing back as you lower.
Push up, focusing on your triceps.
tips: Lock your elbows at the top in a controlled way, do not snap them.

pb_triceps_decline.name: Decline Triceps Push-up
steps: Feet on a stable bench, hands on the green circles.
Lower your body with your elbows tucked, over 3 seconds.
Push up hard.
tips: Lower the bench height if your wrists feel strained.

rope_bicep_curl.name: Rope Bicep Curl
steps: Stand on the board, hook the rope to the board and hold both handles.
Keep your elbows at your sides, palms facing forward.
Bend your elbows until the handles are near your shoulders, then lower slowly.
tips: Increase tension by shortening the rope.

rope_grip_hold.name: Rope Grip Hold
steps: Stand on the board and hold the handles with the rope slightly taut.
Pull the handles to the sides of your body and hold.
Grip the handles firmly for the set duration.
tips: The goal is to build grip strength.

rope_overhead_press.name: Rope Overhead Press
steps: Stand on the board with the handles at shoulder height and the rope behind your arms.
Press the handles straight up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower back to your shoulders in a controlled way.
tips: Tighten your abs so your back does not arch.

rope_overhead_triceps.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand on the board with the rope passing behind your back and the handles behind your head.
Point your elbows forward, close to your ears.
Straighten your arms overhead, then bend slowly.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your head.

rope_row.name: Rope Bent-over Row
steps: Stand on the board, hinge your hips about 45 degrees, back straight.
Pull the handles toward your waist while squeezing your shoulder blades.
Release slowly until your arms are straight.
tips: This exercise complements the yellow zone for your lats.
commonMistakes: Pulling with your shoulders instead of your back.

rope_upright_row.name: Rope Upright Row
steps: Stand on the board with the handles in front of your thighs.
Pull the handles up to your chest, leading with your elbows.
Lower in a controlled way.
tips: Do not raise your elbows higher than your shoulders.
commonMistakes: Shrugging your shoulders to your ears.

rope_squat.name: Rope Squat
steps: Stand on the board shoulder-width apart with the handles at shoulder height.
Sit your hips back as if sitting down, chest upright.
Drive through your heels to stand up.
tips: Keep your knees in line with your toes.

rope_calf_raise.name: Rope Calf Raise
steps: Stand on the board with the handles at shoulder height.
Raise your heels as high as possible and hold for 1 second.
Lower slowly and stretch your calves at the bottom.
tips: Hold onto a wall if you need balance.
commonMistakes: Going too fast without a pause.

rope_woodchop.name: Rope Woodchop
steps: Stand on the board, holding the handle near one hip.
Pull diagonally upward across your body to the opposite side, rotating your torso.
Return slowly, repeat, then switch sides.
tips: The movement comes from your abs, not your arms.
commonMistakes: Twisting your knees and lower back.

rope_deadlift.name: Rope Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand on the board with the handles in front of your thighs, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower the handles along your thighs with a straight back.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
tips: Feel the stretch in the back of your thighs.

rope_thruster.name: Rope Squat to Press
steps: Stand on the board with the handles at your shoulders.
Squat deep, then stand up while pressing the handles overhead.
Lower the handles to your shoulders and repeat.
tips: Use the drive from your legs to help your shoulders.
commonMistakes: Legs and arms not moving as one.

device.name: Multifunction push-up board + resistance rope
safetyNotes: Place the board on a flat, non-slip floor and make sure it does not shift before you start.
Check the rope for cracks or frayed fibers before use. Do not use a damaged rope.
If you feel sharp pain in a joint (shoulder, elbow, wrist), stop exercising.
